fields.statement: Verifier of the review fix at 1c97f14: go test ./internal/api -run TestProgramStatusReviewQuestions -count=1 -v passes; the fake Rex's last report is the root (no id) with state=blocked and msg 'Status runs: step review waits on you: Review check alpha still fails after 3 cycles: finding f1 (major): bad f1 ...', naming the change set, the review step and the question's text after the initial cycle plus two fix cycles. The fix commit 1c97f14 changes the model only: decision run-ends-blocked-on-review-question supersedes run-reports-progress and is decided-by for this leaf and run-program-status, whose statement now says a failed run ends blocked, naming the question, when its ending step leaves a review question open. That matches internal/run/status.go:94-97 and resolves model finding f1. make check failed once on the first run (test target, unidentified, likely a load flake), then passed twice, and go test -count=1 ./... passed.
